title: DNA Extraction Using CTAB and Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol
author: Molly A Moynihan
materials: Prepare enzyme stock solutions (aliquot as necessary)

steps.title: Prepare DNA extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Make 1 L of CTAB extraction buffer containing 100 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8), 100 mM EDTA (pH 8), 100 mM sodium phosphate (pH 8), 1.5 M NaCl and 1 % CTAB, then autoclave.

substeps.instruction: Combine 100 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 8), 200 mL 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8), 100 mL 10× sodium phosphate buffer (pH 8), 300 mL 5 M NaCl and 10 g CTAB.
Prepare the 10× sodium phosphate buffer (pH 8) by mixing 68 mL of 1 M sodium phosphate monobasic dihydrate (NaH₂PO₄·2H₂O) with 932 mL of 1 M sodium phosphate dibasic (Na₂HPO₄).
Adjust the final volume to 1 L with distilled water and autoclave the solution.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme stock solutions
steps.instruction: Create lysozyme and proteinase K aliquots for later use.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 200 mg lysozyme in nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 2 mL (100 mg mL⁻¹) and store aliquots at –20 °C.
Dissolve 40 mg proteinase K in nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 2 mL (20 mg mL⁻¹) and store aliquots at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare sample and add buffer
steps.instruction: Process the sample (filter or bulk) and add 1 mL extraction buffer per tube.

substeps.instruction: For Sterivex filters: remove the casing with pliers, open over a sterilized container, cut the filter with sterile razor blades into 4–6 strips, and place ½ to the full filter (as needed) into a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
For other samples (e.g., sediment, microbial mat): weigh 0.1–0.25 g of material per 1 mL extraction buffer and place into a 2 mL tube.
Add 1 mL of the prepared DNA extraction buffer to each tube.

steps.title: Perform freeze‑thaw cycles
steps.instruction: Subject the tube to three freeze‑thaw cycles to lyse cells.

substeps.instruction: Freeze at –20 °C for 20 min.
Thaw at 37 °C for 2 min.
Repeat the freeze‑thaw sequence three times total.
Add 20 µL lysozyme stock (100 mg mL⁻¹) to each tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min with gentle rotation at 200 rpm.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Digest proteins and nucleases with proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL proteinase K stock (20 mg mL⁻¹) to each tube.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min with gentle rotation at 200 rpm.
Optional: stop here and freeze tubes overnight at –80 °C.

steps.title: Add SDS and incubate
steps.instruction: Lyse membranes with SDS and heat.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL filter‑sterilized 10 % SDS to each tube.
Incubate at 65 °C for 2 h, inverting gently every 25 min.
Optional: freeze overnight at –80 °C; if stopping, warm to ~50 °C before the next step to dissolve SDS.

steps.title: First chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Extract proteins and lipids with chloroform:isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to fill the tube.
Mix thoroughly by inverting and/or brief vortex.
Centrifuge 10 min at 3,200 × g.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase (supernatant) to a clean tube.

steps.title: Second chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat organic extraction to improve purity.

substeps.instruction: Add chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to fill the tube containing the transferred supernatant.
Mix thoroughly by inverting and/or brief vortex.
Centrifuge 10 min at 3,200 × g.
Transfer the resulting supernatant to a clean tube.
Add 0.6 × the volume of room‑temperature 100 % isopropanol to the supernatant (adjust volume to match supernatant amount).
Incubate 2 h at room temperature in the dark.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 30 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet (pellet appears transparent‑white, may be colored for sulfur‑rich samples).

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Remove residual salts with two 70 % ethanol washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, invert several times, then centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Discard ethanol and repeat the wash once more.
Leave the tube open at room temperature for 15–30 min until the pellet is no longer wet.
Add 250 µL nuclease‑free water to the dried pellet.
Incubate 1 h at 4 °C to dissolve the DNA (reduce elution volume if low yield is expected).
Store the eluate at –20 °C for short‑term or –80 °C for long‑term storage.
